title: The Jaeger facts that rest on the bundled all-in-one configuration are CODE facts, not DOC
goal: kb/public/logs/otel-collector-otlp-pipeline.md tags the facts that rest on Jaeger's bundled all-in-one.yaml (it binds each receiver to the JAEGER_LISTEN_HOST default localhost, it sets max_traces 100000) as CODE at the pinned release, and keeps the docs-only parts (unlimited by default, the JAEGER_LISTEN_HOST snippet) as DOC

run:
import re, sys
lines = open("kb/public/logs/otel-collector-otlp-pipeline.md", encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()
items = [l for l in lines if l.startswith("- ")]
def tag(l):
    m = re.search(r"\[(DOC|CODE|DER|UNK|COMMUNITY)\b[^\]]*\]\s*$", l)
    return m.group(1) if m else ""
code_bind = any(tag(l) == "CODE" and "JAEGER_LISTEN_HOST" in l and "localhost" in l for l in items)
code_max = any(tag(l) == "CODE" and "max_traces" in l and "100000" in l for l in items)
doc_cites_yaml = [n for n, l in enumerate(lines, 1) if l.startswith("- ") and tag(l) == "DOC" and "S-fsi2wdg7" in l]
doc_unlimited = any(tag(l) == "DOC" and "unlimited" in l and "100000" not in l for l in items)
doc_listen = any(tag(l) == "DOC" and "JAEGER_LISTEN_HOST" in l and "S-fsi2wdg7" not in l for l in items)
print("CODE fact for the localhost binding:", code_bind, "| CODE fact for max_traces 100000:", code_max, "| DOC facts citing the all-in-one.yaml source:", doc_cites_yaml or "none", "| DOC fact kept for unlimited by default:", doc_unlimited, "| DOC fact kept for the JAEGER_LISTEN_HOST snippet:", doc_listen)
sys.exit(0 if code_bind and code_max and not doc_cites_yaml and doc_unlimited and doc_listen else 1)
